In Paragon, the MLS® system used by local REALTORS®, Whalley is North Surrey sub-area F26. The sections below cover the City Centre Plan, SkyTrain access and the strata records worth reading on a Whalley complex.

Whalley is home to Surrey City Centre, which the City describes as growing into a walkable, transit-oriented downtown for the region south of the Fraser River. Most of its housing near the stations is apartment towers, and townhome complexes tend to sit on the blocks around them. That gives you a front door and often a small yard while staying close to the core.

blocks.text: The City Centre Plan and your complex

parts.t: The City Centre Plan is Surrey's guide for how City Centre grows. Its update enables more transit-oriented development around SkyTrain stations and plans for more parks and amenities as the population rises.

For a townhome buyer, that's the key thing to check. A low-rise complex can share a block with lots designated for towers, which may bring construction, more traffic and changes to light. The same growth also brings new parks, services and shops within walking distance. Look up the land use designation of the lots around any complex you're considering.

Three Expo Line stations sit in Whalley: Gateway, Surrey Central and King George. The Surrey Langley SkyTrain project extends the line from King George Station along Fraser Highway toward Langley City. From Surrey Central Station, the R1 RapidBus runs east along 104 Avenue to
Guildford
Exchange.

blocks.text: Strata records for a Whalley townhome

parts.t: Buying here usually means buying a strata lot. You own the unit, and all owners share the common property through the strata corporation.

Read the strata plan before anything else. A conventional plan bounds each lot by the building's walls, floors and ceilings. A bare land plan bounds lots with survey markers, and its common property is often limited to roads, services and amenities. Which type it is decides who pays for big exterior jobs.

The strata must hand over a Form B within 7 days of a request. It shows the monthly fee, approved special levies, money owing on the unit and the contingency reserve fund. The budget and minutes show what the fee covers and what the council has been discussing.

Stratas with five or more lots get a depreciation report every five years, estimating 30 years of repair and replacement costs for common assets. Check where the complex's roofs, siding, decks and paving stand.
Unless the strata filed its own at the Land Title Office, the Standard Bylaws apply. Ask for the filed set and the rules, and look at pet limits and any rules about yards, patios and parking.

parts.t: I map each complex on your list against the nearest SkyTrain station and the City Centre Plan designations around it. That way you know both your walk to the train and what could be built next door before you make an offer.

Then I go through the strata package with you. For each complex I compare the depreciation report's timing for roofs and siding against the reserve fund, and if they don't match, we ask the strata how the work will be funded. If you're shopping on a budget citywide, my

1. Which SkyTrain stations serve Whalley?
Gateway, Surrey Central and King George stations on the Expo Line are all in Whalley.
2. How does the City Centre Plan affect a Whalley townhome?
The plan guides growth across City Centre, and its update allows more transit-oriented development near the stations. Lots around a complex may be designated for much taller buildings.
3. Where will the Expo Line extension start?
The Surrey Langley SkyTrain extension runs from King George Station along Fraser Highway toward Langley City.
4. Are Whalley townhomes strata properties?
Most are. Check the title and strata plan to confirm the unit is a strata lot and whether the plan is conventional or bare land.
5. Who repairs the exterior of a Whalley townhome?
In a conventional strata using the Standard Bylaws, the strata corporation repairs the structure, exterior, outside doors and windows, and yard fences. Filed bylaws can change that.
6. What documents should I compare between Whalley complexes?
Line up each complex's Form B, budget, depreciation report, filed bylaws and recent minutes, then compare fees, reserves and planned work.
7. Does this page show Whalley condos or houses?
No. It lists townhouses in Whalley only. My Whalley condos page covers apartments, and my Whalley homes page covers every type.
